name: Slop Detector
description: Score any landing page against the AI-design-slop fingerprint. Deterministic, weighted 0-100 scoring of the CSS and copy tells that Cursor, v0, Lovable and Bolt converged on, on real headless Chromium. Plus an AEO axis: can AI engines read & cite a page.

capabilities.name: scan_page
capabilities.description: Score a URL against the design-slop (and optional copy-slop) fingerprint.

capabilities.name: check_aeo
capabilities.description: Score whether AI engines can fetch, read and cite a page (AEO axis).

capabilities.name: list_patterns
capabilities.description: Read the live pattern catalogue (id, label, category, weight).

capabilities.name: fix_prompt
capabilities.description: Build a ready-to-paste LLM prompt to de-slop a page from a scan result.

auth.notes: No API key required for normal use. Per-IP rate limited; browser-driving routes are Turnstile-gated for browser origins. See https://slop-detect.com/auth.md
